title: CAMERA tile enabled by a connected camera (manual until automated)

clauses.text: With no camera connected the CAMERA tile is greyed out and says Connect a camera; choosing it says Connect a USB camera.

steps.do: With no USB camera plugged in, look at the CAMERA tile on the home screen (Web & Media).
steps.expect: The tile is greyed out and says Connect a camera. Choosing it says Connect a USB camera. Say what you see on a Mac, where a built-in camera is not reachable.

clauses.text: Plugging a camera in enables the tile without a restart; the home screen checks about every two seconds.

steps.do: With the tile greyed, plug in a USB webcam and wait on the home screen.
steps.expect: The tile becomes enabled by itself within a few seconds.

clauses.text: Admins, operators and users get the tile; guests do not.

steps.do: Sign in as a guest and look at the home screen, then sign in as a user and look again.
steps.expect: The guest does not get the tile. The user does, when a camera is connected.
